parts.text: I thought you said you wanted this.
You asked for this.
You asked to be different.
You asked to be successful.
You strived for this life…
and now that you're here…
you're complaining that it's hard.
If you want a life better than ninety-nine point nine percent of people…
you need to outwork ninety-nine point nine percent.
You need to be in the zero point one percent.
And guess what they all have in common?
They are obsessed…
with the thing they want to achieve.
So I thought you said you wanted this.
Otherwise, why would you be sitting here?
You told yourself you were going to do it.
So why aren't you doing it?
Go do it.
You can do it…
but you need to be obsessed.
You need to become obsessed.
Go do the thing you said you were gonna do.
